title: elymus submuticus
intro: Elymus submuticus, commonly known as Thick-spiked wheat-grass, is a perennial grass native to China and Mongolia. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Elymus submuticus include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. Bioactive constituents of Elymus submuticus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
